items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Well, I knew Herbert Hall, and Edmund Hall, and Clarence Hall.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's Johnny. He's a good bass. Yeah.

You know, uh, we had, uh, we had the Olympia, we had the Olympia band. Not no, not no, marching band. What's your name? Dancing band. They had the Eureka. That was a dance band, too? Yeah. We had the, uh, blazer way. They had, uh, uh, uh, Yeah.

onwards and all them bands had uniforms. They had about, they had eight, nine-piece bands like that. That's the way they used to run. Big bands, heavy bands. Every one of them had, would have different colored uniforms. And one band had a brown, brown, brown uniform. Now Chicken, he played with one of them bands. I'm trying to think now. You know Chicken the trombone player? Chicken Henry, yeah. Well Chicken can give you more ideas about me and me now because he, he can maybe remember them bands because he played…
